test.quality_policy: Report accuracy, macro F1, per-class/condition/source metrics and confusion. No competition accuracy threshold supplied; do not invent one or tune against this set.
test.limitations: Same simulator/controller and operating-condition family; heavily overlapping windows. Event holdout is not physical independence or new device/domain generalization. Historical teacher experiments are not claimed globally blind.

endurance.latency_policy: Report full and warm timings, overruns and inter-result gaps; 25 ms is a target, not a hard-real-time guarantee.
endurance.memory_policy: Report RSS, warm baseline, peak, final and late-run trend; do not claim absence of leaks from 30 minutes alone.
endurance.transport: preview only; physical AXI and RS485 excluded
